June 19, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Martin Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in Mastercard Inc (MA) by 4.04% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Martin Investment Management Llc sold 6,144 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.48% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 145,877 shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $25.55 million, down from 152,021 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Martin Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Mastercard Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $208.13 billion market cap company.
